PR (cited in the notes as #22485): feat(hydrator): handle sourceHydrator fields from webhook (#19397) [closed]
Cherry-pick of https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/pull/19397, but I had to update it slightly to add the new hydrate flag.

It seems like this was approved and merged into the `hydrator` branch but never brought back into `master`, I'm not sure if this was intentional or not but there does not seem to be an equivalent feature on `master` currently.

Current behavior: webhooks only look at the `syncSource` revision to determine if it needs to trigger a refresh. This means that an upda…

trigger a refresh and does not rehydrate.

Expected behavior: webhooks should look at both the `drySource` to trigger a rehydration and at the `syncSource` to trigger a sync.

I've retested it on my side and it works great.

Resolves https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd/issues/19070
